name: Trader with horses — Mahanabami Dibba relief

sections.Subject & Narrative: A central standing handler appears between two inward-facing horses. Slide 16 places the scene within a discussion of horse trading, wootz steel and textiles.
sections.Iconographic Attributes: No additional securely identified attribute is recorded; unresolved small objects have not been named.
sections.Pose & Gesture: Both arms bend toward the horses; the figure and animals share a narrow baseline. The low relief privileges readable silhouettes over deep spatial modelling.
sections.Material & Technique: Granular stone surface, shallow cut outlines and slightly projecting bodies are visible.
sections.Architectural Placement: Carved panel on the Mahanabami Dibba at Hampi; shown as a detail on 16 and as a recap on 25.
sections.Costume & Ethnic Markers: A long garment and head covering distinguish the handler. The caption says Arab (?) and does not establish ethnicity from costume alone.
